en:
This powerhouse was a karate national champion back in middle school,
but it took a bout against Akiyama to teach him his limits. In his quest
for true strength, he has formed a tag team with his former rival.

Saejima once taught Tokita at the Sodachi Dojo. Now the student has
decided that he is the only suitable tag team partner for his former
master.

This once-promising superstar of pro wrestling lost himself in
an alcoholic haze after an injury shattered his dreams. It took a bout with
Shinada to open his eyes once more. Now he's out to prove something!

Christmas is coming up soon. It'd be good to do something for the kids. Maybe I'll ask Wada-san at the office for advice.
Wada-san saw right through me. I guess I'll try and do what I can.
I'll send money for Izumi's present using the ATM. 5,000 yen should be enough.
I'll send money for Shiro's present using the ATM. 5,000 yen should be enough.
I'll send money for Eri's present using the ATM. 8,000 yen should be enough.
I'll send money for Riona's present using the ATM. 6,000 yen should be enough.
I'll send money for Mitsuo's present using the ATM. 6,000 yen should be enough.
I'll send money for Koji's present using the ATM. 10,000 yen should be enough.
I'll send money for Taichi's present using the ATM. 10,000 yen should be enough.
I'll send money for Ayako's present using the ATM. 20,000 yen should be enough.
I wonder if this will cheer the kids up. Heh, I'm probably just doing it to feel better about myself.
I've finished sending the eight kids money. I hope they have a good Christmas even without me there.
There was apparently a taxi with its emergency light triggered on Nagasu Boulevard.
The taxi just sped off all of a sudden. It looked like it was heading north along Nagasu Boulevard.
It looks like the taxi is headed toward Suzukake Lane.
It looks like the taxi went further south from Suzukake Lane. Maybe I should head to Fukuhaku Street.
This is the guy behind it all! I've got to save the driver.
It looks like we both had it wrong. Well, at least the misunderstanding is sorted out now.
Kiyokawa is having a mixer party at Motsunabe Kaede. I want to help out if I can. Maybe they're still waiting outside.
We made it through that mixer party. It didn't turn out as well as it could have, but those two seemed to be okay.
I have to save that kidnapped kid!
I couldn't catch the kidnapper, but at least the kid is safe now.
I'm glad I caught up to that kidnapper. It's a relief to know the kid is safe now.
That was no ordinary dog howl. I think it was coming from behind the toilets next to the river.
I guess idiots who gang up and prey upon the weak can be found anywhere. I think they need a little wake-up call.
I need to bring Haruka's father to where she is. He should be at Café Portugal on Nagasu Boulevard.
Who'd stoop to taking a young girl hostage? These guys are a lost cause. Time to make them pay.
It was good to see Haruka and her father patch things up. I wish I could see my Haruka...
I have to do something about the chief's computer.
Looks like that messed it up badly. I probably should have stopped the chief.
I'm glad it wasn't anything too serious. I made the right call stopping the chief.
Kudarizaka was looking for someone to stand in for him in a movie. I might still find him on Chikuzengawa Street.
I've got to defeat the zombies just like the script says. It's kind of tricky, though.
They want me fight this horde of zombies? These movie actors have a rough job.
Time for the climactic scene of the movie. Hopefully I can pack plenty of action into it.
I guess I didn't make a very good stand-in actor. The acting business is pretty tough.
It looks like I did an okay job filling in on the movie. This acting business is a lot tougher than I imagined.
Yuya is the last person I expected to see in Nagasugai. Luckily, my true identity wasn't exposed to Muramatsu-san.
It sounds like Yuya has his fair share of troubles, too. I hope things go well for him no matter what he decides.
I got an email from Yuya. Apparently he got a job as a waiter at a cabaret club called La Seine.
Yuya seemed to be doing well at that cabaret club. I'll have to check in on him again sometime.
I wonder how Yuya is doing. Maybe I'll go see him at La Seine.
Heh. Yuya has that same old spark in his eyes again now. I'll give him a hand with these yakuza.
I know you still have things on your mind, Yuya, but good luck back at Stardust.
Maybe a new neighbor came to introduce themselves? I pretended I was out, but I should say hi if they come back.
It's one of those pushy newspaper salesmen. I think I'll rough him up a little to teach him a lesson.
It was too much trouble to talk him around, so I signed up for a newspaper subscription. Talk about a pushy salesman.
That newspaper salesman was about as obnoxious as they come, but I think he'll change his tune now.
A fisherman invited me to do some river fishing. He's toward the north end of Chikuzengawa Street.
It's sea fishing this time. That could be fun. I can meet him toward the north end of Chikuzengawa Street again.
So Kimura-san is the Tuna King, huh? That Dragon Seafood Bowl tasted incredible.
The Spangled Meteor? What sort of girl drives a car like that?
That Nanami girl had heard rumors about me. I wonder if she has something to do with the Spangled Meteor?
I got a challenge from the Spangled Meteor. The driver seems to know me, so maybe it really is Nanami.
I got a challenge from the Spangled Meteor. I lost the last race, but this time I think I can win and unmask them.
The Spangled Meteor is Rena Nanami. She's a good woman who understands the importance of being honest with herself.
So this guy's name is Hors d'Oeuvre Morosawa? He's a little out of control.
I could join him in the ring if I had something to hide my face with. Did I have anything like that at my apartment?
With the dragon mask, I can take part in the bout with Morosawa. I'll go home to prepare then head to Ose Bridge.
I'll make Hors d'Oeuvre Morosawa's retirement fight a fitting end to his career.
Who knew that dragon mask would come in handy? I think Morosawa got the closure he was looking for.
That student who lost his answer booklet looked pretty stressed out. I wonder if he's still at Ose Bridge.
I think that student learned something more important than the answers to his test.
A food stall owner wanted me to help get his stall in place. He's probably still on Meisei Street.
Unless I get that poor guy's food stall in place soon, he won't be able to open on time. I'd better hurry up.
I lugged the food stall over, but it got a bit damaged. At least his patrons won't miss out on their food.
I lugged the food stall over in one piece. Now his patrons won't have to wait for their food.
It sounds like this place is pretty deep in debt. I should ask for more details in case I can help out.
Tatsuya is scouring the country for ideas to use in his new creations. Once he's done, he might be able to lend a hand.
Tatsuya said he was at Theater Square. I should go and meet him there.
I bet Tatsuya can come up with plenty of other masterpiece dishes in the future. I hope he keeps it up.
Mack Shinozuka... I met him in Kamurocho before. He seems to be traveling the world and taking photos again.
Revelations, huh? I guess I'll let Mack know if I capture any moments that strike me as special.
That food stall ramen I had with the chief tasted great. When I get a chance, I want to go and try it again.
Cooking noodles is more hectic than I thought. The guy looked happy, so maybe I'll go help out again sometime.
I got a challenge from the Amon Clan. Once we're all ready, their messenger outside New Serena will take us where they are.
We have to finish things with the Amon Clan. I need to make sure we all get back alive.
I guess there's no end in sight for our struggle with the Amon Clan...
Those hostesses were talkin' about Himura near Rose Hip.
Could be others 'round here who knew Himura. Gotta be a lot of foot traffic passing through the arcade area.
Another one of those arms deals Himura was talkin' about in the slammer could be goin' down. Probably in Ramen Village.
There's supposed to be an arms deal at the plaza in Ramen Village. Cops'll be there, but I better go for a look.
Ain't every day I end up protectin' cops from the mafia. Still, I'll pay back the debt I owe, Himura!
For better or worse, Himura's a show-off. I got taken in hook, line, and sinker. It was still fun, though.
That guy's three sheets to the wind. Better steer clear of him.
That old guy in Ambitious was hammered. Maybe I oughta hear him out at least.
Araseki-han ran off after the bag snatcher! They were headed towards Nakatsuki Street. I better go after 'em.
Losers with no dreams ain't got a right to look down on Araseki-han. I'll show 'em the error of their ways.
So Araseki-han was chasin' old Oshima, huh? I better watch my step next time I see him.
Looks like Sodachi's been workin' on his skills. Let's see how far he's come.
Sounds like Sodachi's trainin' his heart out. Hope he keeps makin' more progress.
Sounds like Sodachi's in some kinda trouble! Better head to the dojo right now.
This place is precious to us. No way I'm gonna let these guys ruin that!
Keep holdin' down the fort for us, Sodachi. That place is special to us all.
Who'd wanna harm Santa? I might go and help out later.
Santa hunters? What's wrong with these guys? I better track 'em down and give 'em a talking-to.
Don't tell me these guys are huntin' down Santas! Guess I'm gonna have to turn tail and run.
Santa hunters, huh? I might help out if I get the chance.
So these're the Santa hunters. Time to give 'em a piece of my mind.
Guess that settles that. I could get used to bein' Santa.
They need me to check where each of the snow sculptures are at. Guess I could pitch in for the sake of the festival.
I was supposed to check where the snow sculptures are at. Gotta tell the guy on the west side of the snow festival.
Looks like I messed up the location of the snow sculptures. Better check one more time and go tell that guy again.
Looks like I messed up the location of the snow sculptures. The snow festival's gonna be fun.
Looks like I got the snow sculpture locations right. I'm really lookin' forward to the snow festival.
Masao said he was headed to Tsukimino. Hope his mom at the village'll be okay.
Gotta deliver this letter to Masao that his mom gave me. Think he was workin' at a place called Apocalypse.
There's a place called Apocalypse near Rose Hip. Gotta deliver this letter to Masao that his mom gave me.
Looks like Masao got set up by that club. He ain't there anymore, so where's he at now?
Looks like Masao's learnin' a few lessons about life. Now I gotta teach these guys a lesson as well!
